name: wait_for_music_wave_load

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_WaitForMusicWaveLoad takes no Script context and returns scheduler state 4 while asynchronous-load bit 56 in D_00388550 is set, otherwise state 2, without accessing the value stack

notes: Command 567 builds an amusic/wave%4d.wd path, queues the file load, and arranges for the associated asynchronous task bit to clear on completion. Every one of the five JP calls immediately follows command 567, so this handler waits for that music wave-data load to finish.
